cohort: 1044 women attending a post-dates clinic (397 receiving CAM, 647 receiving standard care)
finding: While CAM did not reduce induction of labor rates, nulliparous women receiving CAM experienced shorter labors, less oxytocin augmentation, lower epidural rates, and reduced blood loss, while multiparous women using CAM had an increased risk of significant perineal trauma.
mod_finding: Nulliparous women who received CAM had shorter labors, less oxytocin augmentation, lower epidural rates, and reduced blood loss regardless of mode of delivery.
